verdict.rationale: Rendering quality is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies. The pack contains nothing about Godot's 3D renderer: no mention of PBR materials, global illumination, baked lighting, shadows or post-processing. The only nearby items are a Homebrew cask label calling it a '2D and 3D game engine', an anecdote about building a VR scene, and a page on the dedicated 2D renderer, none of which document these renderer features.
